# The Special Wedding

> The Special Wedding provides evergreen, citation-ready information about wedding planning software for professional planners: product features, planner workflows, templates, public pricing, planner resources, and customer outcomes.

The Special Wedding is an all-in-one planning workspace and CRM for professional wedding planners. It consolidates client onboarding, wedding websites, guest management, RSVPs, seating, vendor records, contracts, budgets, timelines, reminders, galleries, and couple communication into one planner-controlled platform.

The marketing site at https://thespecialwedding.io is written for independent planners and planning agencies. Couples working with a planner use The Special Wedding through a planner-invited couple portal. Couples planning their own wedding can also purchase Couple Lifetime Access directly — a one-time $199 fee for one wedding workspace.

## Core Content

### Platform Overview

- Wedding planning software and CRM tailored for professional planners
- Centralized workspace for multiple weddings, couples, vendors, guests, forms, files, timelines, budgets, and communications
- Planner dashboard, couple portal, vendor directory, resources library, public blog, and template collection
- Multi-tenant product model: each planner or agency manages its own weddings, team members, clients, vendors, and records
- Public marketing pages include feature explanations, real workflow examples, current product screenshots, pricing tiers, founder perspective, FAQs, and free resources

### Features And Workflows

- Operations management for wedding projects, deadlines, reminders, budgets, packages, and day-of timelines
- Wedding website and couple portal for RSVP collection, guest-facing details, gallery uploads, forms, and planner-couple messaging
- Guest management for guest lists, plus-ones, dietary needs, accessibility notes, seating assignments, and RSVP status
- Seating orchestration with table planning, capacity awareness, and guest-detail context
- Planner-owned vendor CRM and public vendor directory for discovery, private contacts, assignments, agreements, files, and payment context
- AI-assisted tools for package pricing, contract drafting, vendor outreach, cash-flow guidance, and planning content
- Communication tools for planner inboxes, reminders, invitations, support threads, and couple messaging
- Media and guest memories features for collecting and organizing wedding-day photos and gallery uploads
- Calendar and scheduling workflows for planner tasks, meetings, reminders, and external calendar sync where configured

### Pricing Plans

The public pricing model uses two paid planner plans plus a one-time couple offer (there is no free plan):

- **Solo Founding**: $49/month founding-member rate for independent planners. Includes unlimited weddings, unlimited guests, vendor management, seating orchestration, automated reminders, Google and Outlook calendar sync, 300 AI credits per month, 25GB guest memories storage, and email support.
- **Solo Standard**: $99/month standard rate for independent planners. Includes everything in Solo Founding plus 750 AI credits per month and 50GB guest memories storage.
- **Couple Lifetime Access**: $199 one-time fee for couples planning their own wedding — not a subscription, nothing renews. Includes one wedding workspace with full planning tools for the whole planning window: guest list and RSVP tracking, a wedding website, galleries, and data export, for the lifetime of the wedding.

Both planner plans can be billed monthly or annually; annual billing costs ten times the monthly price (two months free).

Both planner plans include a 30-day free trial with no credit card required at signup. Couple Lifetime Access is a single one-time payment with no trial and no renewal.

### Founder And Workflow Proof

The Special Wedding's public marketing proof is grounded in the current product and its connected planner workflows. The founder perspective explains why the platform was built: the individual tools were not the core problem; the gaps and handoffs between them were. Public proof focuses on current full-window product views and concrete planner outcomes rather than unverified customer quotations.

Representative outcomes include:

- Fewer disconnected spreadsheets and subscriptions
- Faster vendor follow-up and clearer team handoffs
- More repeatable planning workflows across several weddings
- Better couple visibility without exposing private planner operations
- A planner-owned record that stays connected across the wedding lifecycle

### Common Questions

- Existing guest lists can be imported from spreadsheets.
- Each wedding has its own workspace, guest list, budget, seating, branding, and couple-facing portal.
- Vendor relationships are managed through private planner-owned records; the public vendor directory is separate and vendors are not given access to the planner workspace.
- Customers can export their data. After cancellation, account data is retained for 30 days before permanent deletion.
- The Special Wedding differs from generic CRMs because it includes wedding-specific tools such as seating charts, guest RSVPs, timelines, guest memories, vendor contracts, and planner AI workflows.

## Optional Context

The Special Wedding is operated by JOATLABS. The product is purpose-built for professional wedding planning workflows rather than generic project management retrofitted for events.

Related public content includes planner education, software comparisons, pricing strategy articles, AI workflow guides, contract guidance, seating strategy resources, and blog articles synced through the BabyLoveGrowth publishing pipeline.
